findings.detail: The configured distributed launcher starts four ranks, but codebook initialization is only entered by rank 0. Each VQLayer.init_codebook calls distributed.broadcast when a process group is initialized, so rank 0 blocks waiting for ranks that instead reach the barrier at line 319. The available training metrics report world_size=1, so they do not demonstrate that the configured distributed entry point works.
findings.reproduction: Run the script via its default _launch_via_torchrun path with four available GPUs. Rank 0 enters init_codebook and blocks in the first broadcast at model/layers.py:142-143; ranks 1-3 wait at train_rqvae.py:319. Training never begins.
findings.correction: Make codebook initialization a collective operation with all ranks participating in the same broadcast sequence (for example, have rank 0 compute KMeans centers and broadcast each level's centers to all ranks), or otherwise remove the rank-local broadcast while ensuring all rank models receive identical initialized codebooks. Then exercise the four-rank launcher.

findings.detail: The new trainer exports the reordered SID JSON into its experiment tree, while the real Stage 3 entry point's CODE_PATH remains the frozen baseline results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/item_sids.json. Thus the normal Stage 3 trainer will not consume this implementation's SID/permutation; the fact that both files are named item_sids.json does not connect them. The JSON format and contiguous zero-based keys produced here do match the Stage 3 loader contract, but the artifact is not wired into that entry point.
findings.reproduction: Run the trainer and then run stage3_T5Train/train_HG-Rec.py without editing configuration: it resolves CODE_PATH to results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE/item_sids.json (line 157), not the experiment tree's item_sids.json. Stage 3 therefore trains with the baseline ordering or fails if that baseline file is absent.
findings.correction: Wire the Stage 3 run configuration/CODE_PATH to this experiment's exported item_sids.json (and preserve the experiment-specific output naming), or export to the exact per-variant path selected by the Stage 3 entry point. Verify loaded rows retain zero-based item-ID alignment and the level permutation is the one used to generate those rows.
